setup.host: sections 2-7 rows: AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12C/24T WSL2 (desktop proxy), nice -n 10, <=8 threads, CPU-only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''); section 8 laptop validation on m0pad: see laptop_m0pad
setup.workload: experiments/serving/prefill/manifest.json (freeze v2, seed 20261018, 20 sessions / 220 events from TRAIN DAT10 sidecar)

dev75_latency.usage: single DEV75 latency use 2026-10-17: dev75-baseline + dev75-eager runs, no scoring

parity.note: prefix-cache splits reorder FP reductions; the shipped cache_prompt behavior already drifts vs cold; mismatches are near-tie alternative continuations

rejected_levers.--cache-reuse 256: gain was host-load noise; cached fracs unchanged; parity 0.9909
rejected_levers.--cache-prompt off: typing events would pay full recompute (baseline cached .954 on type)

4t_contended_band.note: load ~26 band, same-band anchor rows; ratios within band only

4t_interleaved_ab.method: alternating single-rep tg32 runs, drift-cancelling under contention
4t_interleaved_ab.verdict: 4T decode ordering Q4_K_M > Q6_K > Q8_0; 8T ordering Q6_K > Q8_0 ~ Q4_K_M — tier recommendation flips by thread count (laptop: Q4_K_M, desktop: Q6_K), pending fidelity gates

layout_simulation_v2.verdict: reordering/capping shows no byte-prefix gain; retraining-for-ordering not justified

abort_immediate.finding: client abort does NOT cancel the in-flight prefill or free the slot; the follow-up queues behind the still-running warm-up

abort_wait2s.finding: the warm-up completes server-side after the client leaves

pool_restore_control.finding: the original 69ms 'abort keeps partial KV' was the unified KV pool restoring an earlier full context

cross_slot_restore_B.finding: slot-0 request reuses slot-1-warmed prefix via the pool

concurrent_C.finding: CPU contention, not queuing, while the other slot prefills

auto_slot_D.finding: auto selection avoids the busy slot

interrupt_probe.flow_consequence: drop abort-on-pause (does nothing server-side; queued request lands at floor when warm-up completes); optional --parallel 2 warm-up lane for pause-during-warm-up

recommended.request_flow: token-id /completion prompts; n_predict:0 warm-up after every document change (open/cursor settle/accept/edit/diagnostic/switch targets + debounced keystrokes); on pause send the real request directly (it queues behind any in-flight warm-up and lands at the floor when it completes); optional --parallel 2 warm-up lane; stream from first token

race_bound_stale1.description: one document change races every warm-up, no refresh (pessimistic bound)
race_bound_stale1.interpretation: typing pauses land between 64ms (floor) and 265ms (mid-burst pause); settle events hold the floor when the pause follows the settle warm-up by more than the debounce

zero_debounce_async_p1.description: fire-and-forget warm-up + immediate request (pause races the warm-up), 1 pass, host load 15-25 (~2x other arms' band)
zero_debounce_async_p1.mechanics: queued request interleaves with the in-flight warm-up (cache_n at request start == warm-up progress); TTFT ~= warm-up remaining + tail ~= structural cost; a warm-up pays only when it completes before the pause
zero_debounce_async_p1.parallel2_full_run: skipped as moot: single-slot interleaving avoids worse-than-structural waits; revisited-state reuse already served by the KV pool (switch_back)

cache_ram_2048_validation.finding: pool capping to 2048 MiB is free at realistic session working sets

slot_persistence_probe.verdict: adopt for restarts: ~50x on post-restart first opens; composes with warm-up flow

q6k_eager_floor.note: speed characterization only; fidelity/gating belongs to the quant mission

tokenize_probe.verdict: send token IDs: faster and training-exact; text path identical but ~5-23ms slower per request

laptop_m0pad.host: AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 5650U 6C/12T (Zen 3), 14.9 GiB RAM, CachyOS kernel 7.2.9-2-cachyos, glibc 2.44, amd-pstate-epp 'powersave' (default), on AC, nice -n 10, CPU-only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='')
laptop_m0pad.config_deviation: -t 6 (all physical cores) instead of -t 8; all other flags identical to the desktop runs

hashes_reverified_on_host.note: sessions/model re-hashed on m0pad; llama-server byte-identical to the desktop build-cpu binary

laptop_m0pad.method: 4 single-pass runs interleaved eager/baseline/eager/baseline + 1 extra -t 4 arm; fixed llama-bench -p 512 pre-burn before every run; 30 s host-state sampler (load1/Tctl/clock/mem)

host_state.other_processes: idle desktop session (~1% of threads) untouched; Tctl 70-76 C with flat timings across passes (the sampler's all-core mean clock mixes busy and idle SMT siblings and is not a throttle metric)

drift_check.verdict: both arms inside 1% across passes; no drift to correct, one matched band

floor_mechanism.note: floor = one single-token prompt eval (logits for the first sampled token come from that pass); memory-bound: fixed weight-read pass + KV readback

switch_back_pool_miss.note: identical five sessions on every desktop freeze-v2 run; content-determined (LCP restore miss), not host/RAM

host_state.note: cold package start (32.6 C) with a 1.7 min pre-burn
